concepts.label: server-list
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - this page's own subcommand; no promoted tool: id exists for it yet

relations.subject: tool:couchbase-cli-server-list
relations.evidence: If no port number is specified for the server then the port number is 8091.

notable_absence.finding: server-list.md and host-list.md (this same batch) are functionally near-identical: same SYNOPSIS shape, identical HOST FORMATS / CERTIFICATE AUTHENTICATION / ENVIRONMENT AND CONFIGURATION VARIABLES boilerplate, and near-identical single-sentence DESCRIPTION prose ('Returns a new line separated list of all servers in the cluster' vs 'Displays a list of hostnames corresponding to each node in the cluster'). Each links to the other in SEE ALSO, but neither page ever states whether the value each returns ('server', a hostname-or-IP-address) is the identical list under a different name, or a materially different one. A reader is left to guess whether 'server' and 'host' denote the same underlying cluster-membership list.

cross_component_finding: See notable_absence: this is a clean instance of the round's 'near-identical siblings, unreconciled small inconsistencies' pattern - two commands with copy-pasted boilerplate and no page settling whether they are the same list under two names.
cross_product_finding: Plainly none - the page is too thin to carry any product-comparison signal.
